title: BUGFIX — Auto-set warmup_complete=true in warmup-status.json when threshold reached
rationale: check-ready.ts and go-live.ts both compute effectiveDays and exit 0 when >= 3, but neither wrote warmup_complete=true back to warmup-status.json. Any downstream script checking status.warmup_complete directly would still see false forever. Fix: add auto-write of warmup_complete + warmup_completed_at to both scripts when threshold is first crossed.
success_criteria: When effectiveDays >= MIN_DAYS, warmup_complete=true written to warmup-status.json
warmup_completed_at timestamp written on first completion
Idempotent — subsequent runs don't overwrite if already complete
WARMUP_OVERRIDE_DAYS env skips file write (test isolation preserved)

tasks.description: check-ready.ts + go-live.ts: write warmup_complete=true + warmup_completed_at when effectiveDays >= MIN_DAYS for first time
